# Stormberry AS

> Stormberry AS is an operational AI partner based in Norway. We put AI into daily operations, score the sales pipeline against strategy, and turn the result into a synthesis ready for the next strategy review. Sovereign by default: your data stays on your infrastructure and the agents run behind your firewall.

Founded by Marcos Thomassen Povoa after fourteen years in industrial and maritime sales. The practice runs as one loop in three motions: daily operations, sales pipeline, strategy. Specialised corporate training for EU AI Act Article 4 (AI literacy and compliance) is delivered inside the first motion. We work natively in English, Norwegian, Portuguese and French, and our deliverables adapt to local communication styles. Contact: info@stormberry.as, +47 950 43 789, Askøy, Vestland, Norway.

## Core pages

- [Stormberry AS](https://stormberry.as/): What an operational AI partner is, the loop in three motions, and who it is for.
- [How we work](https://stormberry.as/services): The three motions set out one by one, and what a client actually receives.
- [The loop in full](https://stormberry.as/ai): The longest description of the operational AI practice, motion by motion.
- [AI on your sales pipeline](https://stormberry.as/sales): Deals scored against your strategy so the right opportunities surface. Less time on noise.
- [AI in your strategy](https://stormberry.as/strategy): The year's actual pipeline and operations data used to update the strategy, so it describes reality plus an aim rather than a wish list.
- [Global delivery](https://stormberry.as/culture): Cross-cultural communication built into how every motion is delivered, not sold as a separate service line.
- [About Stormberry AS](https://stormberry.as/about): The company, the founder, and the industrial and maritime sales background behind it.
- [Contact](https://stormberry.as/contact): Encrypted form and PGP-signed email. No cookies and no analytics. We reply within one business day.

## Specialist offerings

- [EU AI Act Article 4 training, in Norwegian](https://stormberry.as/ai-act-artikkel-4-opplaering): Half-day and full-day courses in AI literacy (KI-kompetanse) for Norwegian companies, updated after the July 2026 rule change.
- [OnSide AI partnership](https://stormberry.as/partnerships): Stormberry AS is the official OnSide AI distribution partner for Norway, bringing real-time AI video intelligence to Norwegian industry.
- [Stormberry Labs](https://stormberry.as/labs): A live portfolio of functioning AI prototypes, each built in a single session and published as a working tool.
